notes:
Initial real alpha for controlling an explicitly selected, already running official VerySync v2.33.2 instance. Includes authenticated identity/version policy, fresh typed status, guarded folder registration/configuration reads, partial label/pause changes, unregistering without a file-deletion request, bounded failures/reconciliation, constrained raw requests, capability snapshots and three working examples.

The exact source passed six native controller/engine combinations (macOS, Windows and GNU Linux, each amd64/arm64), current/minimum Rust, doc-tests, strict lint/docs, actual compiled examples, fault cases and exact cleanup. The actual crate also passed clean Rust 1.85 dependency consumption and isolated example execution.

Pin `verysync-sidecar = "=0.1.0-alpha.1"`. All alpha APIs are unstable. This is an intermediate milestone: owned runtime, full P2P, events/tasks, program acquisition/upgrades, history/storage, commercial authorization, other architectures/minimum systems and final cross-network acceptance continue in the same full-delivery project.

The official program is separately licensed and is not included. See the repository's getting-started guide and alpha scope for precise verification limits.
